caseTitle: places: list, editor, CRUD, refusals, default rules, delete and reload

observations.text: A disposable namespaced user with one onboarded place; creates, renames, default changes and deletes are real writes. Only the named equipment read, default change and viability refusal are answered locally for that user.
Saving a nameless place is refused before any write: the Name field is marked invalid and takes focus.
Create then rename are real save_location writes: after a full reload the renamed place is listed and stored once.
The delete confirmation is a native dialog: focus is held inside it while open and Escape dismisses it without deleting.
The default cannot be deleted until another place is made default; a failed default change rolls back; the confirmed delete removes the stored row and survives reload.

dispositions.reason: The locations read is Boot-watched; BootGate withholds the route tree while it is pending.
A failed Boot-watched locations read is answered by Boot’s retry before this route mounts; the footer Retry branch is covered by the mounted component test.
